Further pinned-source investigation narrowed the historical seam evidence: direct generate succeeded through pre-admission RPC, not by switching in the late generate hook; the registry fixture supplied captured variants and explicitly configured a named seam-live variant; restart evidence continued with a new prompt, not automatic suspended-session recovery. Native accepted input is session.inbox.enqueued with sessionID, inboxID and user/synthetic item; inboxID matches prompt.messageID. session.execution.started and model.request do not prove acceptance of an arbitrary staged candidate.
